name: Axum
workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
database_layer: SQLx 0.9 (Axum has no ORM; its examples use SQLx)

phase2.validation: Path, Query, Json and Form extractors (type errors: 400, Json data errors 422); ranges checked by hand (422)

csrf.mechanism: axum_csrf 0.12 (token in an encrypted cookie, HMAC in the form field)

notes: A/A control: an identical copy of frameworks/axum, measured against it on the same runner; unranked.
role_note: An identical copy of the Axum baseline (every file but bench.json and README.md is byte-identical; `harness.py validate` checks it), measured like every other implementation against Axum on the same runner. Its scores should be 1.00; their largest deviation is each category's A/A margin, one term of the tie margin (docs/v3-spec.md section 12). Unranked.
